description: SQL-language CREATE/DROP FUNCTION and PROCEDURE plus pg_proc catalog visibility
sql: CREATE FUNCTION diff_fn() RETURNS INT LANGUAGE SQL AS 'SELECT 42';
SELECT proname, prokind FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc WHERE proname = 'diff_fn';
CREATE PROCEDURE diff_proc() LANGUAGE SQL AS 'SELECT 1';
SELECT proname, prokind FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc WHERE proname = 'diff_proc';
